item.title: 'It's only been 8 hours': Donald Trump threatens to impose 'secondary sanctions' on India; hints at possible ban on China
item.description: Amidst deepening India-Russia oil ties, President Trump has escalated sanctions against New Delhi by imposing an additional 25% tariff, bringing the total to 50%. India's external affairs ministry swiftly condemned the increase as unfair and unreasonable, emphasizing that its oil imports are driven by energy security needs. Trump also hinted at potential secondary sanctions against China for similar actions.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: 'False': US Rep. Cory Mills accused of revenge porn threat; accuses Lake County Commissioner Sabatini of orchestrating smear campaign
item.description: Florida Rep. Cory Mills faces accusations of releasing intimate videos and images after a breakup with a former beauty pageant titleholder. Mills denies the claims, attributing them to a political attack by Anthony Sabatini, a former rival. The investigation has been transferred to the Florida Department of Law Enforcement, while Mills pledges full cooperation to clear his name.

item.title: Saudi Arabia remains GCC's biggest borrower in H1 2025 despite 20% YoY drop in debt issuance
item.description: Despite a nearly 20% drop from last year, Saudi Arabia led the GCC debt market in H1 2025, raising $47.93 billion and accounting for 52.1% of total issuances. The region collectively issued $92.04 billion, with the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman trailing. Conventional bonds gained preference as corporate activity surged across the Gulf's maturing debt landscape.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: The Spectator wins defamation claim brought by Muslim activist who criticised Hindus
item.description: The Spectator magazine and Douglas Murray have emerged victorious in a defamation case brought by Mohammed Hijab, a Muslim online influencer. Hijab claimed a Spectator article about the 2022 Leicester riots defamed him by portraying him as a street agitator who incited followers against Hindus.

item.title: US-Russia diplomacy: Trump's envoy meets Putin for 3-hour ‘productive’ talk; sanctions still on table
item.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff met with Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin for three hours amidst efforts to end the Ukraine war. This meeting occurred before a deadline for Russia to agree to peace or face new sanctions. Donald Trump hinted at diplomatic progress, stating the meeting was "highly productive.

item.title: Donald Trump's pay check: 'Proud to be the only President' to donate his entire salary
item.description: Donald Trump announced on Truth Social that he will donate his presidential salary, echoing his first-term practice. His initial paycheck will support White House renovations, reminiscent of efforts to enhance the 'People’s House.' Trump's 2024 earnings exceeded $600 million, fueled by cryptocurrency, golf properties, and licensing deals, contributing to his estimated $1.6 billion net worth.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Saudi Arabia wins fifth overall medal with bronze at 2025 International Nuclear Science Olympiad in Malaysia
item.description: Azam Khaled Al-Omari from Saudi Arabia won a bronze medal at the 2025 International Nuclear Science Olympiad in Malaysia, marking the Kingdom’s fifth overall win. Oman earned one silver and two bronze medals at the event, which featured 56 students from 14 countries and was endorsed by the IAEA. Saudi participation was led by Mawhiba, with support from the Ministry of Education, KACST, and K.A.CARE, promoting peaceful nuclear innovation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Helicopter crash in Ghana: 8 killed; defence, environment ministers among dead
item.description: A devastating helicopter crash in Ghana has claimed the lives of eight individuals, including two prominent government ministers: the defence minister and the environment minister. The helicopter, en route to a gold-mining region, lost contact before the tragic incident. Investigations are underway to determine the cause of this national tragedy, marking one of Ghana's worst aviation disasters in recent years.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: JD Vance's Epstein strategy dinner with Kash Patel today: 'Missing from this group is....'
item.description: Vice President JD Vance will be hosting a strategy session concerning the Epstein case, specifically focusing on the potential release of Ghislaine Maxwell's DOJ interview transcript. Ahead of the meeting, Virginia Giuffre's siblings issued a statement condemning how the administration is not reaching out to the victims of Epstein-Maxwell.

item.title: India-US trade war: White House issues statement as Trump imposes extra 25% tariff — here's the full text
item.description: In response to India's continued purchase of Russian oil, US President Donald Trump has imposed a 25% tariff on Indian imports, effective August 27. This action aims to counter Russia's actions in Ukraine and deter support for its economy. Trump warned other nations may face similar tariffs for importing Russian oil.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE participates in 3rd UN Conference on Landlocked Developing Countries in Turkmenistan
item.description: The Third UN Conference on Landlocked Developing Countries (LLDC3) opened on 5 August 2025 in Awaza, Turkmenistan, uniting leaders to address the unique challenges of 32 landlocked nations. With the launch of the Awaza Programme of Action (2024–2034), the conference aims to boost sustainable development through regional partnerships, infrastructure investment, trade facilitation, and climate resilience strategies.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 51-foot-tall statue of Lord Ram unveiled in Canada's Mississauga, mayor says 'spectacular landmark for Hindu community'
item.description: A towering 51-foot statue of Lord Ram, inspired by the Ayodhya temple, has been unveiled in Mississauga, becoming North America's tallest. Made in Delhi and assembled in Canada, the statue can withstand high winds and is visible from Toronto airport. The inauguration was celebrated by the Hindu community and attended by Canadian politicians, marking a significant spiritual landmark.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pakistani businessman jailed in London for threatening Virgin Atlantic airhostess with gangrape: 'You called me a...'
item.description: Salman Iftikhar, a London businessman, received a 15-month jail sentence for his appalling behavior on a Virgin Atlantic flight from London to Lahore in 2023. He verbally abused an air hostess, making threats of gangrape and violence, fueled by accusations of racism. Iftikhar has six previous convictions arising from 15 offences, including common assault in 2004 and drink driving in 2008.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE mass weddings: Young couples can now apply for 11th annual ceremony in Sharjah, December 2025
item.description: Sharjah Charity International has opened applications for its 11th mass wedding, scheduled for December 2025 during the UAE’s 54th National Day celebrations. The initiative supports first-time grooms facing financial challenges, promoting family stability. Rooted in Emirati tradition since 1998, the program continues evolving with digital registration and expanded eligibility for citizens and select long-term residents.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who was NYC designer Martha Nolan, found dead on a boat in Long Island after late-night screams?
item.description: Irish designer Martha Nolan, 33, was found dead on a boat at the Montauk Yacht Club in mysterious circumstances. Police responded to a 911 call and found Nolan unconscious; she was later pronounced dead. The cause of death is currently unknown and under investigation, with an autopsy scheduled. Witnesses reported hearing screams and seeing the boat owner seeking help, running naked.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Arrested from India-bound plane before take off: American couple jailed in Singapore for stealing Louis Vuitton, Dior products at airport
item.description: American nationals, Kapadia Husain Zoher and Kapadia Amatullah, were arrested at Changi Airport for stealing luxury goods worth over $750 while in transit to Mumbai. The husband, a dentist, received an 18-day jail sentence, while the engineer wife was sentenced to a week after pleading guilty to theft charges. Singapore has strict laws against theft, with offenders facing swift investigation and prosecution, especially in transit zones like Changi Airport.
